name: Fever
verdict: Fever is a live-entertainment tech platform co-founded and led by its three founders, funded by institutional investors (Goldman Sachs, EQT, Point72); no state or state-fund owner in the chain and no human-rights finding against the company. Nothing found.
note: Fireballs GC partner (logo links to feverup.com, verified in the livgolf.com/fireballs-gc HTML, 2026-10-03). On livgolf.com/partners Fever is listed among LIV Golf's Official Suppliers: 'As a Marketing & Technology Partner, Fever powers the LIV Golf ticketing journey' (verified 2026-10-03). No state or state-fund owner found, no human-rights finding found.
